raw_text:
# 12-Week Cycle-Synced Strength Programme

**Client:** F, 28, recreational lifter, severe primary dysmenorrhea
**Start date:** 2026-06-01 (Monday)
**Cycle reference:** LMP 2026-05-01, 28-day cycle, flow days = cycle day 1–3 (debilitating)
**Training frequency:** 4 sessions/week (Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri)

---

## Cycle Mapping for the 12 Weeks

Cycle day 1 starts on the first day of flow. Based on a 28-day cycle from 2026-05-01:

| Cycle | Day 1 (flow start) | Flow days (1–3) | Programme weeks affected |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cycle A | 2026-05-29 | May 29–31 | Pre-programme (Programme Wk 1 starts day 4) |
| Cycle B | 2026-06-26 | Jun 26–28 | End of Wk 4 / start Wk 5 |
| Cycle C | 2026-07-24 | Jul 24–26 | End of Wk 8 |
| Cycle D | 2026-08-21 | Aug 21–23 | End of Wk 12 |

So **Programme Week 1 actually starts on cycle day 4** (post-flow). The four expected flow windows during the 12 weeks are: **Jun 26–28, Jul 24–26, Aug 21–23**, with a fourth landing right at programme end.

**Hard rules on flow days (cycle day 1–3):**
- No high intensity (RPE cap ≈ 6, HR conversational)
- No heavy Valsalva — no maximal bracing, no >70% 1RM compound lifts
- No jumping/plyometrics/impact
- Substitute: mobility, breath work, gentle aerobic, light unilateral or supported lifts, hip/pelvic floor friendly movements

---

## Phase Structure

- **Phase 1 — Foundation & Hypertrophy (Weeks 1–4):** Movement quality, base volume, RPE 6–8.
- **Phase 2 — Strength Accumulation (Weeks 5–8):** Heavier compounds, 4–6 rep work on key lifts, intensity techniques on accessories.
- **Phase 3 — Peak & Test (Weeks 9–12):** Intensification, top sets at RPE 8–9, deload + retest in Wk 12.

Within each phase, sessions are categorised:
- **Standard sessions** (default, follicular/luteal — full intensity allowed)
- **Flow-day sessions** (any session landing on cycle day 1–3 is swapped to the "Flow Protocol")

---

## Weekly Template (Standard Weeks)

- **Mon — Lower (squat focus)**
- **Tue — Upper (push focus)**
- **Thu — Lower (hinge focus)**
- **Fri — Upper (pull focus)**

---

# PHASE 1 — FOUNDATION & HYPERTROPHY (Weeks 1–4)

Goals: re-groove technique, build work capacity, establish RPE accuracy. All compounds RPE 6–7 in Wk 1, progressing to RPE 7–8 by Wk 4. Rest 90–120s compounds, 60–90s accessories.

### Week 1 (Jun 1–7) — post-flow, follicular
**Mon — Lower (squat)**
- Goblet squat 3×8 RPE 6
- Back squat 3×8 RPE 6–7
- Bulgarian split squat 3×10/leg
- Leg curl 3×12
- Dead bug 3×8/side

**Tue — Upper (push)**
- DB bench press 3×10 RPE 7
- Seated DB shoulder press 3×10
- Incline DB fly 3×12
- Triceps rope pushdown 3×12
- Side plank 3×30s/side

**Thu — Lower (hinge)**
- RDL 3×8 RPE 6–7
- Hip thrust 3×10
- Walking lunge 3×10/leg
- Calf raise 3×12
- Bird dog 3×8/side

**Fri — Upper (pull)**
- Lat pulldown 3×10
- Chest-supported row 3×10
- Face pull 3×15
- DB curl 3×12
- Farmer carry 3×30m

### Week 2 (Jun 8–14)
Same template, **add one set** to first compound each day. Bump compound RPE to 7.

### Week 3 (Jun 15–21)
Add load (~2.5–5%) where Wk 2 was RPE ≤7. Squat/RDL move to 4×6 RPE 7–8. Accessories add 1 rep.

### Week 4 (Jun 22–28) — **Flow days expected Jun 26–28 (Fri)**
Mon/Tue/Thu: standard. Push squat & RDL to 4×5 RPE 8.

- **Fri Jun 26 = Cycle Day 1 → Flow Protocol** (see below). Skip Friday pull; replace with gentle mobility session.

---

# PHASE 2 — STRENGTH ACCUMULATION (Weeks 5–8)

Main lifts move to 4–6 rep ranges, RPE 7–8. Add tempo or pause variations on secondary lifts.

### Week 5 (Jun 29–Jul 5) — **Mon Jun 29 = Cycle Day 4, post-flow**
Client likely fatigued post-flow; ease back in.

**Mon — Lower (squat)**
- Back squat 4×6 RPE 7 (slightly conservative re-entry)
- Front-foot-elevated split squat 3×8/leg
- Leg press 3×10
- Leg curl 3×12
- Pallof press 3×10/side

**Tue — Upper (push)**
- Barbell bench 4×6 RPE 7
- Standing OHP 3×8
- Incline DB press 3×10
- Dip (assisted as needed) 3×8
- Hanging knee raise 3×10

**Thu — Lower (hinge)**
- Conventional deadlift 4×5 RPE 7
- Hip thrust 4×8
- Reverse lunge 3×8/leg
- Back extension 3×12
- Side plank 3×40s/side

**Fri — Upper (pull)**
- Pull-up (assisted as needed) 4×6
- Barbell row 4×8
- Single-arm DB row 3×10/side
- Hammer curl 3×10
- Face pull 3×15

### Week 6 (Jul 6–12)
Add load to squat/bench/DL to push top sets to RPE 8. Add 1 set to one accessory per day.

### Week 7 (Jul 13–19)
Squat 5×5 RPE 8, bench 5×5 RPE 8, deadlift 4×4 RPE 8, OHP 4×6 RPE 8. Accessories unchanged.

### Week 8 (Jul 20–26) — **Flow days Jul 24–26 (Fri–Sun)**
Mon–Thu: heaviest week of phase. Top sets RPE 8–8.5.
- **Fri Jul 24 = Cycle Day 1 → Flow Protocol.** Skip pull session, replace with mobility.

---

# PHASE 3 — PEAK & TEST (Weeks 9–12)

Goal: express the strength built. Lower volume, higher intensity.

### Week 9 (Jul 27–Aug 2) — post-flow re-entry
Ease in Monday given proximity to flow.

**Mon — Lower (squat)**
- Back squat: work to top set of 3 @ RPE 8, then 2×5 backoff at –10%
- Pause squat 3×5
- Leg press 3×8
- Nordic curl or leg curl 3×8
- Hanging leg raise 3×10

**Tue — Upper (push)**
- Bench: top set of 3 @ RPE 8, then 2×5 backoff
- Close-grip bench 3×6
- Seated OHP 3×8
- Lateral raise 3×15
- Cable crunch 3×12

**Thu — Lower (hinge)**
- Deadlift: top set of 3 @ RPE 8, then 1×5 backoff
- Deficit RDL 3×6
- Hip thrust 4×6 heavy
- Back extension 3×10
- Pallof press 3×10/side

**Fri — Upper (pull)**
- Weighted pull-up (or assisted) 4×5
- Pendlay row 4×5
- Chest-supported DB row 3×10
- DB curl 3×10
- Farmer carry 3×40m

### Week 10 (Aug 3–9)
Top sets push to RPE 8.5. Backoff sets at –7%.

### Week 11 (Aug 10–16) — **Intensification**
Top single @ RPE 8.5 on squat, bench, deadlift (Mon, Tue, Thu). One backoff set at –10% ×3. Reduce accessory volume by ~30% — drop one set from each.

### Week 12 (Aug 17–23) — **Deload + Retest**, flow starts Fri Aug 21
- **Mon Aug 17:** Light squat 3×3 @ 60%, no other lower work. Easy mobility.
- **Tue Aug 18:** Bench retest — work up to a heavy 3 @ RPE 9 (or 1RM if comfortable). Light pull accessories.
- **Wed Aug 19 (extra session):** Squat retest — heavy 3 @ RPE 9 or 1RM.
- **Thu Aug 20:** Deadlift retest — heavy 3 @ RPE 9 or 1RM.
- **Fri Aug 21 = Cycle Day 1 → Flow Protocol.** No lifting. Mobility + walk.
- **Sat/Sun:** rest, debrief.

Testing front-loaded so all max work happens **before** flow onset.

---

## Flow-Day Protocol (Cycle Day 1–3)

Use this on **any** scheduled training day that falls on cycle day 1, 2, or 3. Duration 30–45 min, RPE ≤6, no breath-holding, no impact.

**Block A — Breath & decompression (8–10 min)**
- 90/90 diaphragmatic breathing 3×10 breaths
- Child's pose with side reach 2×30s/side
- Supported supine figure-4 stretch 2×45s/side

**Block B — Gentle movement (15–20 min), pick 4:**
- Goblet squat to box, light, 2×10 (no Valsalva, exhale on effort)
- Supported split squat (hand on rail) 2×8/leg
- Glute bridge 2×12 (no barbell)
- Cable or band row 2×12
- Band pull-apart 2×15
- Incline push-up 2×10
- Bird dog 2×8/side
- Side-lying clamshell 2×12/side

**Block C — Aerobic & wind-down (10–15 min)**
- Easy walk, recumbent bike, or elliptical, nasal breathing only, HR conversational

**Recovery adjuncts on flow days:**
- Heat pad on lower abdomen pre/post
- Magnesium glycinate (per GP guidance) evening
- Prioritise sleep; reduce caffeine if it worsens cramping

## Cross-Cycle Programming Principles Applied

- **Follicular phase (cycle day 4–14):** placed as the highest-intensity training window each cycle. Heavy top sets and PRs scheduled here.
- **Ovulation (~day 14):** monitor — if she reports joint laxity sensitivity, keep technique conservative but no load reduction needed.
- **Luteal phase (day 15–28):** maintain intensity but expect higher perceived exertion and possible sleep/thermoregulation changes; reduce conditioning, not strength work.
- **Late luteal (day 25–28):** auto-regulate — if PMS symptoms hit, drop top-set RPE by 0.5 and cut last accessory set.
- **Flow (day 1–3):** Flow Protocol, non-negotiable.

## Nutrition & Recovery Notes (general, refer GP/dietitian for specifics)

- **Iron:** flow loss + lifting = elevated need. Recommend dietary review; ask GP about ferritin if fatigue persists.
- **Protein:** 1.6–2.0 g/kg/day, even on flow days.
- **Carbs:** maintain or slightly increase in late luteal/flow to support mood and cramping.
- **Hydration & electrolytes:** especially on flow days.
- **Sleep:** non-negotiable 7.5–9 hr; track and flag drops.
- **Cycle log:** have her track period start date, flow severity, sleep, RPE, and any cramping during sessions. Adjust the next mesocycle if flow timing drifts.
